shortDescription: Creates a resource of CCE/Node in Huawei Cloud

options.name: access_key
options.description: Specifies the access key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Specifies the name of the AZ where the node is located.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Specifies the endpoint of the cloud. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the cluster to which the node belongs.

options.name: data_volumes
options.description: Specifies the data disks of the node.

options.name: ecs_group_id
options.description: Specifies the ecs group id. If specified, the node will be created under the cloud server group.

options.name: eip_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the elastic IP address assigned to the node. Only elastic IP addresses in the DOWN state can be assigned.

options.name: extend_param
options.description: Specifies the extend parameter of the node, key/value pair format.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply when deciding whether existing resources match and should be altered. The item of filters is the name of input options.

options.name: fixed_ip
options.description: Specifies fixed IP of the NIC.

options.name: flavor_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the node flavor.

options.name: identity_endpoint
options.description: Specifies the Identity authentication URL. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: k8s_tags
options.description: Specifies the tags of the kubernetes node, key/value pair format.

options.name: key_pair
options.description: Specifies the key pair name when logging in to select the key pair mode.

options.name: max_pods
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of instances a node is allowed to create.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the node name. Value requirements: Consists of 1 to 64 characters, including letters, digits, hyphens (-), periods (.).

options.name: os
options.description: Specifies the operating System of the node.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the root password when logging in to select the password mode.

options.name: postinstall
options.description: Specifies the script required after installation. The input value must be a Base64 encoded.

options.name: pretinstall
options.description: Specifies the script required before installation. The input value must be a Base64 encoded.

options.name: project_id
options.description: Specifies the of ID of the project to login with.

options.name: region
options.description: Specifies the Huawei Cloud region.

options.name: root_volume
options.description: Specifies the system disk of the node.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: Specifies the secret key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the subnet to which the NIC belongs.

options.name: tags
options.description: Specifies the tags of the node, key/value pair format.

options.name: taints
options.description: You can add taints to created nodes to configure anti-affinity.

options.name: timeouts
options.description: The timeouts for each operations.
